This 2016 BMW 2 Series 218i M Sport offers a refined driving experience that balances performance with everyday practicality. As an M Sport variant, this vehicle features a 1.5 litre petrol engine that meets Euro 6 emission standards. The exterior is equipped with a Xenon Headlight Package, which includes automatic activation for added convenience during night driving or in low light conditions. Inside, the cabin is designed for connectivity, featuring enhanced Bluetooth telephone preparation with a USB audio interface and voice control, alongside a dedicated Bluetooth hands free facility. Parking is made simpler with the inclusion of rear Park Distance Control, which uses rear sensors to assist with manoeuvring into tight spaces.

The efficiency of this model is a significant highlight, as it achieves an impressive fuel economy of 50 mpg. This level of efficiency, combined with its low CO2 emissions, makes it a sensible choice for those looking to manage running costs without compromising on the quality associated with the BMW brand. By integrating advanced technology like the automatic headlight system and comprehensive parking assistance, this vehicle provides a modern and user friendly experience that stands out in its class.
